runtime: Independent pure-Python arbitrary-precision integer sums; two threshold/reset populations; no NumPy, Torch or training-module imports; no task labels in NeuralRuntime.tick/output
scope: Exact serialized quantized network only, at declared synchronous spike boundaries; not continuous Brian2 LIF, consciousness, arbitrary tasks, or other training seeds

all_binary_state_space_analysis.fixed_point_method: Start from valid current/one-step outputs; propagate failures through every predecessor to obtain greatest safe closed subset

selective_transfer.mask_bit_convention: bit i selects donor neuron i; all other neurons retain recipient spikes
selective_transfer.future_criterion: immediate observed fingerprint matches hybrid AND patched code belongs to greatest safe set under all six command/nuisance events

whole_state_donor_control.meaning: all donor outputs and every future composition preserved; not a selective hybrid transfer

selective_transfer.lesion_controls_semantics: One-time zeroing at a complete memory-spike boundary, followed by the original network. Permanent lesions are separately checked below.

permanent_lesion_search.semantics: Permanently clamp selected memory neurons to0 after each threshold/reset phase, before output and subsequent recurrence; existing spec lesions retained
